photos.llama_desc: A man in a red rain poncho and a fedorahat is showing a group of children a large animal skull. He is holding it in his right hand and is pointing to it with his left. The children are all wearing rain ponchos and are standing around a red tablecloth-covered table.
photos.oracle_desc: A man in a red rain poncho and wide-brimmed hat holds up an animal skull for a small group of children, who are gathered around a red-covered table in a park on a rainy day. The children are wearing rain gear in red, pink, and yellow. A second adult woman in a red poncho stands in the background near a pink umbrella.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a white top and long blue skirt stands on a stage, holding a black book or book-like object. She has long, dark hair and is looking directly at the camera. She is standing in front of a blue curtain.
photos.oracle_desc: A young woman in a white off-the-shoulder top and long grey-blue skirt stands alone on a dark stage, reading from a black book or folder held in both hands. She faces forward in front of a large blue curtain backdrop. The stage lighting leaves the surrounding area in deep shadow.

photos.llama_desc: A yellow and green train car on a hillside. The train car is on a track on a hillside with a metal structure in the background. The train car has a green and yellow sign on its side.
photos.oracle_desc: A yellow mine car or narrow-gauge rail vehicle sits at the right edge of a rocky, scrub-covered hillside at dusk, with a tall wooden headframe structure silhouetted against a pale grey sky in the center background. The scene appears to be at a historic mine site. The lighting is very low, rendering most of the landscape in near-silhouette.

photos.llama_desc: A large, empty storefront with a sign reading "Chuck E. ...". The sign is above a large, metal door with a sign reading "Chuck E. ...". The sign is above a large, metal door with a sign reading "Chuck E. ...".
photos.oracle_desc: An exterior view of a Chuck E. Cheese's restaurant building, showing the full colorful logo sign mounted on a plain brick facade at dusk. Tree shadows are cast across the building wall and the parking lot in the foreground is mostly empty. No entrance doors or metal doors are visible in the frame.

photos.llama_desc: A group of five children sitting on top of a large, stone, animal-shaped bench in a park. The children are all wearing casual, summer clothing and are smiling at the camera. The bench is shaped like a bear, with a large, stone, bear-shaped head and a smaller, stone, bear-shaped body.
photos.oracle_desc: Five children pose on and around a large concrete animal-shaped sculpture in a sunny park, with four sitting on top and one lying underneath between the legs. The sculpture appears to be a seal or sea lion rather than a bear, with a smooth rounded body and no ears. The children are dressed in summer clothes and are smiling toward the camera.

photos.llama_desc: A large, cracked, and worn-out concrete floor with a dark brown color and a mix of small, light-colored stones and darker, darker-colored rocks. The floor is cracked and has a few large, dark brown, and lighter-colored patches, and a few small, white, and darker-colored rocks are scattered throughout. The floor is set in a dimly lit, dark, and somewhat empty space.
photos.oracle_desc: A close-up of a worn concrete or aggregate floor surface showing a prominent crack running diagonally across the frame, with embedded pebbles and a slightly polished texture. The floor appears reddish-brown with a pale circular patch near the center, and there is a faint blue light visible at the lower-left edge. The image appears to be a detail shot taken in a dimly lit interior.

photos.llama_desc: A large purple and orange dragon-shaped bouncy castle with a slide and a big mouth full of white teeth, with two children inside. The children are sitting on the slide, one boy in a red and white striped t-shirt and blue shorts, and one girl in a pink t-shirt and pink bow.
photos.oracle_desc: Two young toddlers sit at the base of a large purple inflatable bounce house or slide shaped like a monster or dragon, with an oversized open mouth lined with white teeth forming the entrance. The children are seated on the inflatable landing mat in front of the mouth opening; both appear to be wearing casual summer clothing. The inflatable is set up outdoors on grass at what appears to be an outdoor event.

photos.llama_desc: A red and white lighthouse made of paper or paper-like material, with a red and white striped design, a red and white top, and a red and white base, on a blue tablecloth or table covering. The lighthouse is on a grey or silver base or board, with a black string or wire attached to it. The lighthouse is on a blue table or tablecloth, with a blue tablecloth or table covering.
photos.oracle_desc: A handmade model lighthouse decorated with red, white, and black bands stands on a flat grey foam or cardboard base on a dark surface, with a clear plastic dome at the top. A black power cord or wire runs from the base, suggesting the lighthouse has an internal light. The background is dark and out of focus, with only faint details of a room visible.

photos.llama_desc: A mallard duck standing on a grassy bank, looking over its shoulder. The duck has a brown and white body, a yellow and black head, and orange feet. It is standing on a grassy bank, with its back to the camera, looking over its shoulder.
photos.oracle_desc: A mallard duck stands on the muddy edge of a pond or lake, facing left in profile with a green-tinged water surface visible behind it. The duck has the characteristic iridescent dark head, brown-streaked body, and orange feet of a male mallard in non-breeding plumage or a female. A narrow strip of grass borders the water's edge where the duck is standing.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a pink party hat with a My Little Pony design, sitting in a chair with a white and pink striped back. She is wearing a pink shirt and has a big smile on her face. In the background, a man in a striped shirt is standing behind her, and a chair with a black tablecloth is to her left.
photos.oracle_desc: A young girl wearing a pink My Little Pony birthday party hat smiles warmly at the camera, dressed in a bright pink top. An adult man in a striped shirt is partially visible in the upper-right background. The setting appears to be an indoor birthday celebration with household furniture visible in the background.
